title: Graph-Based Pseudo-multimodal Contrastive Learning for 12-Lead ECG Representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.26964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) is a standard, non-invasive examination widely used for diagnosing coronary artery disease, where clinical interpretation relies on comparing waveform patterns across multiple leads. However, most existing ECG analysis methods focus on single-lead signals or treat each lead independently, and typically process ECG signals as one-dimensional time-series data using CNNs or RNNs. While effective in modeling local waveform changes, such approaches have difficulty capturing inter-lead dependency and global waveform patterns essential for clinical diagnosis.   To address this limitation, we propose a graph-based pseudo-multimodal contrastive learning framework called Graph-CMMC. ECG waveforms are transformed into Gramian Angular Difference Field (GADF) images to construct complementary representations of the same cardiac activity, enabling a pseudo-multimodal learning setting. translated_title: 基于图结构的伪多模态对比学习用于12导联心电图表示
translated_abstract: 12导联心电图（ECG）是一种标准、非侵入性的检查方法，广泛用于冠状动脉疾病的诊断，其临床解读依赖于对多个导联波形模式的比较。然而，现有的大多数ECG分析方法侧重于单导联信号或将每个导联独立处理，且通常使用CNN或RNN将ECG信号作为一维时间序列数据进行处理。虽然这些方法在建模局部波形变化方面有效，但难以捕捉对临床诊断至关重要的导联间依赖性和全局波形模式。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于图结构的伪多模态对比学习框架，称为Graph-CMMC。ECG波形被转换为Gramian Angular Difference Field（GADF）图像，以构建同一心脏活动的互补表示，从而实现伪多模态学习设置。利用全部12个导联，Graph-CMMC对齐...
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Graph-CMMC的图结构伪多模态对比学习框架，通过将12导联ECG波形转换为GADF图像并利用图结构捕捉导联间依赖性和全局波形模式，克服了现有方法仅关注局部或单导联的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph-based pseudo-multimodal contrastive learning framework called Graph-CMMC, which transforms 12-lead ECG waveforms into GADF images and leverages graph structures to capture inter-lead dependencies and global waveform patterns, overcoming the limitations of existing methods that focus only on local or single-lead signals.
